narr: Thunderstorms impacted the region bringing damage and flash flooding to Eastern Washington.
ev: Heavy rain from thunderstorm caused road washout on LeClerc Creek Road. Washout measured 8 feet deep and 25 feet across. Radar estimated around 1-1.25 inch of rain fell.

A quasistationary thunderstorm over the area produced nearly half an inch of rain. Flash flooding occurred on White River Road between mile markers 4 and 6. There were at least ten areas where mud and debris crossed the road. The road was impassable and was closed for several hours.
